units.source_text: 这一天正是十月初第一个亥日，宫中照俗例吃“亥儿饼”。

en.t: This day happened to be the first Day of the Boar in early October, when the court customarily ate boar-child cakes.

units.source_text: 因公子尚在丧服之中，此事并不大事铺张，只是在一只美丽的桧木食物盒里装了各色各样的饼，送给紫姬。

en.t: Because the prince was still in mourning, the occasion was not made into a grand affair; various kinds of cakes were simply placed in a beautiful cypress food box and sent to Lady Murasaki.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看见了，便走到南面的外殿里，召见惟光，对他说：“明日替我做这样的饼，不必太多，不必各色各样，只要一色的，于黄昏时分送到西殿来。

en.t: When Prince Genji saw them, he went to the outer hall on the south side, summoned Koremitsu, and said to him, "Tomorrow, make cakes like these for me. There need not be many, nor many varieties; one kind will do. Bring them to the west wing at dusk.

units.source_text: 今天日子不好，所以要明天做。”

en.t: Today is not an auspicious day, so they must be made tomorrow."
As he spoke, a smile appeared on his face.

units.source_text: 惟光是个机敏人，立刻会意，并不详细叩问，一本正经地答道：“这个自然！

en.t: Koremitsu was a quick-witted man and understood at once. Without asking for details, he answered with a perfectly serious face, "Naturally!

units.source_text: 定情之始的祝贺，当然要选日子。

en.t: For a celebration marking the beginning of a bond of love, one must of course choose the right day.

units.source_text: 明天是子日，那么这‘子儿饼’要做多少呢？”

en.t: Tomorrow is the Day of the Rat, so how many of these rat-child cakes should I make?"

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“今天的三分之一。”

en.t: Prince Genji said, "One third of today's amount."

units.source_text: 暗示明天是新婚第三日。

en.t: This hinted that tomorrow would be the third day of the marriage.

units.source_text: 惟光心照不宣，领命而去。

en.t: Koremitsu understood without saying anything, accepted the order, and went away.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想：“这个人真能干！”

en.t: Prince Genji thought, "What a capable man he is!"

units.source_text: 惟光不告诉别人，在家里替主子做饼，几乎全是自己动手的。

en.t: Koremitsu told no one, but made the cakes for his master at home, doing almost all the work with his own hands.
